turns.query: What is the capital of Australia and why is it not Sydney?
turns.answer:
The capital of Australia is Canberra. [E1]  
Canberra was founded in 1913. [E1]  
It was chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne. [E2]  
New South Wales wanted the capital to be in Sydney while Victoria wanted it in Melbourne. [E5]  
Because of this disagreement, a new city was built rather than selecting either existing city.

Canberra's estimated resident population was 487,202 at 31 December 2025 (ABS) [E1].  
With an annual growth of about 1.3%, it is projected to pass 490,000 residents during 2026 [E1].  
Separate metro‑area estimates for 2026 put the population at 489,000, a 1.24% increase from 2025 [E3][E5].
